name: wrench
description: Wrench scripting language: syntax highlighting, language server and debugger (local, TCP and serial targets)

wrench.executablePath.description: Path to the wrench executable (wrench.exe on Windows). Empty uses the copy bundled with the extension (Windows and Linux x86-64), then 'wrench' on the PATH.

wrench.nonStrict.description: Allow variables without 'var' (compile with -nostrict) when checking files.

wrench.compileDebugInfo.description: 'Compile to Bytecode' embeds debug information and the source, so the file can be debugged on a target.

wrench.trace.server.description: Trace the communication with the wrench language server.

program.description: The .w source file to debug, or a .bin compiled with -debugsource (used as it is, the source shown is the one embedded in it).

enumDescriptions: Run in a VM inside the debug adapter
A wrench debug server reachable over TCP (ESP32 WiFi, wrench dbgserver...)
A wrench debug server on a serial port (UART, USB CDC)

serialPort.description: Serial port of the target: COM3 on Windows, /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux.

target.description: Alternative to transport/host/port: local, tcp:<host>:<port> or serial:<port>[:<baud>].

upload.description: Upload the freshly compiled program to the target before running it.

project.description: wrench.json describing the host application. The local target then loads only its libraries and stands in for its functions. Empty uses the nearest wrench.json above the program, "none" ignores it.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for each reply from the target.

connectTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a TCP connection.

trace.description: Log the Debug Adapter Protocol traffic to the adapter's stderr.

program.description: Local copy of the program the target runs: its .w source or a .bin compiled with -debugsource. Leave empty to read the symbols and source embedded in the target's bytecode.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause as soon as the target executes script code.

target.description: Alternative to transport/host/port: tcp:<host>:<port> or serial:<port>[:<baud>].

project.description: wrench.json describing the host application, used to name missing functions in errors. Empty uses the nearest wrench.json above the program, "none" ignores it.

configurationSnippets.label: Wrench: Launch locally
configurationSnippets.description: Run and debug the current file in a local VM

configurationSnippets.description: Upload and debug on a device or wrench dbgserver over TCP

configurationSnippets.description: Upload and debug on a device over UART / USB serial

configurationSnippets.description: Debug what a device already runs, without uploading
